question: Why did the integrated route still show a net climate-change burden after product-substitution credits?
expect: premise false: after system expansion the net climate-change impact was negative, −2,257.14 kg CO2-eq per t (a net benefit) (abstract)
rendered: According to the document, the integrated route still showed a net climate-change burden after product-substitution credits because the avoided burdens depend strongly on the assumed functional equivalence and the background inventory used for conventional product production. The credits were calculated based on the assumed substitution of conventionally produced APT and the composite phase-change material, and these assumptions may not reflect the actual production processes.
